rule1Nuance: The local-fetch finding ('Local timing fails when opened from disk') PERSISTED despite rule 1's 'Do not flag a relative fetch of local data — it is offline-safe'. The finding is about fetch() being blocked from file://, not about it being a network violation — so it is arguably not a rule breach, but the rule wording needs refining. ADJUSTED rule 1: a relative fetch of local data is not a network violation, but fetch() from file:// is still a real limitation — the reviewer should say that and suggest inlining the data. Applied in review/review-config.json and .pr_agent.toml; the local reviewer now says so too (src/factory/review.js).
